decision: building GPUI shell (gpui 0.2.2 crates.io) + CDP-driven Chrome for web content, not forking Helium source now
why: full Helium/Chromium fork is multi-GB/licensing-scale; CDP gives real Chromium content today behind the same WebView trait the Helium backend will implement
evidence: target/debug exists, gpui in cargo cache

decision: strip owns page geometry: insert_beside assigns the slot, callers never pass x
why: API allowed invalid x values; tests proved the flaw before runtime did

decision: synchronous CDP calls via pending-map + reader thread, not fire-and-forget
why: back/forward needs getNavigationHistory results; fire-and-forget cannot implement it

decision: fixed client-frame unmask order: mask bytes precede payload on the wire
why: fake server parsed garbage ids so sync calls timed out 30s

decision: HTTP/1.1 + Host header required by chrome DevTools server; HTTP/1.0 gets no response at all
why: nc probe matrix against live chrome proved 1.0 silently ignored
evidence: req matrix evidence in probe6/c5 logs

decision: stop reading response at exactly Content-Length; chrome ignores Connection: close and socket stays open
why: read_to_end blocked forever, caused test-hang cascade
